commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

90+4' Burnley slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Emile Smith Rowe and he is replaced by Timothy Castagne (Fulham).

86' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Zian Flemming tees up Oliver Sonne (Burnley) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Bernd Leno.
85' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaps to collect the ball.

84' Zian Flemming (Burnley) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Bernd Leno anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lesley Ugochukwu walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
82' That's a clear yellow card. Kenny Tete (Fulham) goes into the book.
81' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

81' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Armando Broja (Burnley), but the defence gets it clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Burnley.
80' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) tries to find Harry Wilson, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
79' Substitution. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) has come on for Alex Iwobi.

77' A substitution has been made. Jacob Bruun Larsen goes off and Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) comes on.

77' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
75' A player from Burnley commits a rough challenge. Michael Oliver blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
74' The attendance for today's match is 19739.
73' Burnley seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

68' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaps to collect the ball.
68' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. Burnley have a corner.

62' Substitution. Florentino makes way for Marcus Edwards (Burnley).
59' Armando Broja (Burnley) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' 1 - 3 Samuel Chukwueze feeds the ball through to Harry Wilson (Fulham), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:3!

56' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) makes a decision to dribble through the defence towards the goal. He gets inside the box, pulls the trigger, but hits the ball very poorly and it goes yards wide of the target. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
55' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
54' Lyle Foster (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Burnley will take a corner kick.
52' The foul by Lyle Foster (Burnley) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
51' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
50' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to find Emile Smith Rowe, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
48' A player from Burnley commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
48' A corner kick by Burnley is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
48' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Burnley win a corner.
47' Axel Tuanzebe (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
47' Burnley are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The corner is flicked onto Maxime Esteve (Burnley), but his close-range header flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
45+1' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno was alert and the score remains the same. Burnley earn a corner.

44' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Burnley are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

42' CLOSE! Lyle Foster (Burnley) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
41' Fulham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

39' Harry Wilson (Fulham) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
38' The ball is crossed into the box and Armando Broja (Burnley) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno gets a glove on it to thwart him.
37' What was Joachim Andersen (Fulham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
37' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
36' Josh Cullen (Burnley) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. It's a throw-in for Fulham.

33' The corner from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka.
33' The ball is cleared after Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Fulham get a corner.

26' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

24' A player from Burnley commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
24' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) will deliver the corner kick.
23' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Josh Cullen plays a pass to the feet of Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:1.
20' Lyle Foster (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Burnley are taking a throw-in.
18' Armando Broja (Burnley) picks up a long through ball, but Bernd Leno deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
17' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
16' Michael Oliver interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Florentino (Burnley). A free kick has been awarded to Fulham.
15' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Burnley.

14' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The linesman signals a throw-in for Burnley.
12' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

12' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper reacts well to punch the ball clear. Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
12' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is about to take a corner kick.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Burnley.

11' He should have scored! Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Bernd Leno makes an easy save. The ball is out of play and Burnley manage to earn a corner.

9' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Harry Wilson delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is lurking. His bullet of a shot from close range goes low into the middle of the goal and it's 0:1.
9' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
9' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
8' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Flag goes up against Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) on the edge of the box.
4' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.

3' A pass into the penalty area from Lyle Foster (Burnley) is intercepted by the defence.
